description: Price Intelligence Phase 1 - Extract prices from receipts via OCR, store in prices database, and alert users when same product costs more at different stores. Foundation for future price hike detection.
steps: Create lib/models/price_data.dart model with fields: id, productName, storeName, price, date, category, source (from which expense_id or receipt)

Add prices table to db_service.dart in _createTables(): CREATE TABLE prices (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, store_name TEXT, price REAL NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, expense_id INTEGER, created_at TEXT)
Enhance ocr_service.dart to extract line items from receipts: after text extraction, parse lines matching pattern 'ItemName ... ₱XX.XX' or 'ItemName XX.XX' and store each as separate price record

Create lib/services/price_intelligence_service.dart with methods: (1) addPriceFromReceipt(productName, store, price, date, category, expenseId) to insert price record, (2) findPriceComparisons(productName) that queries prices table for same product at different stores and returns list sorted by price, (3) checkForPriceAlerts() that scans recent prices (last 7 days) and finds products where user paid more than lowest known price

Add UI to expense detail view (edit_expense_screen.dart or new detail dialog): when expense has receipt photo, show 'View Price Comparison' button that calls PriceIntelligenceService.findPriceComparisons() and displays bottom sheet with prices at other stores
Add home screen alert card: call PriceIntelligenceService.checkForPriceAlerts() daily and show banner like '💡 Price Alert: Eggs at Store A cost ₱70 vs ₱84 at Store B (save ₱14)' with dismiss button
acceptance_criteria: Receipt OCR extracts line items and stores each as price record in database
Price comparison feature shows same product at different stores with prices sorted low to high
Home screen shows price alert when user recently bought product at higher price than known alternatives
Prices table correctly stores product name, store, price, date, and links to source expense
No duplicate price alerts for same product within 7 days
verification: Test scenario 1: Scan receipt with 3 line items → verify prices table has 3 new records with correct product names and prices
Test scenario 2: Add 'Eggs' at Store A for ₱84, then add 'Eggs' at Store B for ₱70 → price comparison shows both, sorted with ₱70 first
Test scenario 3: After adding ₱84 eggs when ₱70 option exists → home screen shows price alert banner
Test scenario 4: Dismiss price alert → banner does not reappear for same product for 7 days
findings:
Implementation completed successfully. All components created:
- price_data.dart model with proper serialization
- prices table added to database schema
- OCR service enhanced with extractLineItems() method using regex patterns for price extraction
- price_intelligence_service.dart with fuzzy matching for product names, price alert generation with ₱5 minimum savings threshold, and 7-day dismissal logic
- Edit expense screen shows 'View Price Comparison' button when photo exists, displays bottom sheet with prices sorted by lowest first
- Home screen displays price alert card with dismiss functionality
- Price extraction integrated into add_expense_screen.dart to auto-populate prices table when receipt photo is attached

Build verification: flutter analyze shows only pre-existing info-level warnings (curly braces, const constructors, etc.), flutter build apk --debug completed successfully.

Manual testing requires running on device/emulator with test receipts. Price intelligence features are passive and won't affect existing functionality.
